definitions.pair: S-NPP detection with a NOAA-20 granule covering its h3_r6 cell starting 30–70 min after (or before), nearest per direction, ERA5 tcc<0.3 on that pass
definitions.concordant: ≥1 NOAA-20 detection (conf n/h) within 1,000 m with acq_ts in [pass start −10 min, pass start +16 min]
definitions.strata: season of the detection (summer May–Oct) × its own daynight flag
definitions.sampling: source detections sampled to ≤200,000 with default_rng(20261014) when more
